# Blue Collar Tips & Reviews

> Ratings, reviews and tips for field service companies. One QR code or text link at the end of every job lets a customer rate the work, leave a review and tip the employee who did it.

Blue Collar Tips & Reviews helps field service employees (towing, HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, cleaning, delivery, install/repair, and more) get recognized more often for doing good work. A company-branded page, delivered by QR code or text link, captures a rating, feedback and a tip in one tap. Happy customers are sent on to Google and other review sites; anything less than great comes to the company first. Tips are paid securely through Stripe. Blue Collar Tips & Reviews is operated by Blue Collar AI, Inc.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bluecollartips.app/): What Blue Collar Tips & Reviews does, how it works and who it's for.
- [Tip pooling for field service teams](https://bluecollartips.app/guides/tip-pooling): How automated tip pooling and employee/company splits work, with legal guardrails.
- [FICA tip credit (Section 45B) guide](https://bluecollartips.app/guides/fica-tip-credit): How employers claim the FICA tip credit on Form 8846, and the records they need.
- [Sign in or sign up](https://bluecollartips.app/auth): Create a company account or redeem an employee invite.
